lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The festival's finally tomorrow!
Yeah. It's been crazy busy.
During break time, I sit facing Arcana as we talk.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That means...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: we don't have many days left here at the school either.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Sigh* I wish this could last forever.
Arcana leans over the desk and gives a long stretch.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Do you want to skip class today and go hang out?
Didn't you just say tomorrow is the festival?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We've already finished all the preparations anyway.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Come on, pleaaase?
Hmm...
Arcana, who had been clinging to me, pulls away.
And then...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Our time at school is almost over...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There aren't many chances left for us to make memories together.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So, even if it's just a little while more...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want more... more time with you... *Sob*
Isn't it about time you switched up your act?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why? It's still effective.
I stand up and grab my bag.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, thanks, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So, where should we go?
Didn't we say we'd go back to sing karaoke again last time?
Let's head to the Ark first.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh. You remembered?
Of course.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. Since you paid last time,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: this one's on me.
Dinner too?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah. And coffee.
I was only kidding. I'll buy dinner.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, come on. Isn't your wallet pretty tight too?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's okay to let someone treat you once in a while.
You think I'm that hard up?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Forget I said anything!
Arcana and I proceed to skip school,
starting with karaoke, then hitting up cafes and restaurants popular on social media, a sticker photo booth, and more...
Hold on, something about this seems familiar.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Right? This is exactly what we did on the day we first met.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm not as adventurous as you might think.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I usually just do the same things.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Still, it's my first time doing this with you as a student.
Fair enough.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: This way.
Arcana grabs my hand and pulls me along.
Is there somewhere you want to go?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, it's just ahead.
I follow Arcana,
and end up at a small playground near a residential area.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Haha, I've always wanted to go on

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: a playground date!
Hmm...
I sit on the swing next to Arcana, letting myself swing back and forth.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You look kind of confused.
Yeah, a little...
But why a playground of all places?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Um... How do I explain it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You see it a lot in comics and TV shows, you know.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And it kinda makes you feel like a kid again,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: which, I guess, makes you more honest?
I think I get what you mean...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
Arcana slowly swings back and forth.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: How was my singing, by the way?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I really nailed it this time, right?
You seemed to be struggling with some of those high notes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey, for a regular person, I did a good job!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Besides, you weren't exactly blowing the roof off the place, either.
Hey, for a commander, I did a good job.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well, I admit my heart was definitely doing somersaults.
What, are you just trying to make me look like the bad guy now?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hahaha.
For a while, the creaking of the swings is all I hear in the playground.
Even so, the silence doesn't bother me.
Somehow... having Arcana at my side just feels right.
So, did you have fun today?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, I had a blast!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm so tempted to skip school again tomorrow.
That's not happening.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What about after the festival?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
Arcana looks at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey.
Yeah?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I really like you.
... Yeah, me too.
Arcana narrows her eyes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What's with that weird pause?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I can almost hear you thinking, "Hm... This is awkward, but I guess I should say it back."
Since when did you get into doing impressions?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
Arcana looks up at the sky once more.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Honestly, though, that's something I like about you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's like... you always choose your words carefully, even when it's just a single-word response.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I can tell you try to say things that uplift others and make them feel good.
I feel the same way about you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh really?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Okay, then... what else do you like about me?
Hmm...
I find myself going over everything, from when I first met Arcana until now.
First off, you have such a way with words.
I love how responsible you are with your work...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Uh-huh.
And the way you express your gratitude.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
And...
Seeing Arcana so eager makes me want to play a little trick on her.
Honestly, you're gorgeous, and you have an amazing figure.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, really now?
Uh...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hm? What's wrong?
Oh, it's nothing. I just thought you'd pout and say something like, "What was that supposed to mean?!"

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why would I be upset?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There's nothing better than the person you like telling you you're pretty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Did you catch that? I just taught you a secret trick.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If I ever get sulky or angry,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: all you have to do is tell me I'm pretty, and I'll forgive you in a heartbeat.
I could see you getting a little sulky, sure,
but I just can't picture you actually getting angry.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I can get mad too, you know? Like...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: if you were flirting with another girl right in front of me,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'd really get upset!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Just imagining it makes me so mad!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course, I can't stop you, but just don't let me find out.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Otherwise, you're toast. Both of you.
What'll you do if she's stronger?
You're not exactly a fighter.
You're really pretty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I was just joking...
Did it work?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No! I'm still mad, and I plan to stay that way!
You're really, insanely pretty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Hmph.
Hehe.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Don't laugh!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I mean, I don't want you crying either...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ugh, let's just go already.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Aw, okay... It's always the one who's more invested that gets the short end of the stick, huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess I'll just go along with it.
Even though she says it grumpily, she still slips her arm around mine.
What do you like so much about me anyway, Arcana?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm...
Arcana thinks it over for a moment.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If I start now, we'd still be at it long after the festival ends.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'll tell you later in the Forbidden Library...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If that's okay with you, of course.
Without a word, I pull Arcana closer.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, this feels good.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: In that case, want to check out my tarot shop?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We haven't actually been there, have we?
Weren't you kicked out?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The place became vacant again, so I moved back in.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Makes you wonder why they kicked me out in the first place.
Arcana grabs her bag.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's see... ah!
Arcana subtly glances around at the other students.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: W-we should try to leave quietly.
... Y-yeah.
We sneak out of the school and after a while, arrive in front of Arcana's tarot shop.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehehe. Welcome to my kingdom... wait, no!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Since this is the main base of operations, welcome to my empire!
The shop isn't very big.
The sign says...
"Whispers of Fate?"

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah. I named it myself.
*Creak*
Arcana opens the door and goes in.
*Jingle*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Bet it's cleaner than you expected.
I didn't say anything.
Did that hit a nerve?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: N-no!
Arcana goes inside.
Soon she brings out some coffee and lemon tea.
*Clink*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Want some snacks? I've got a bunch of different things.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Just so you know, they're all really expensive.
Really?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yep! I'm aiming for a high-end tarot shop vibe.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Customers would trust me more that way.
Right...
Arcana sets out various snacks.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: All right then!
Coffee, lemon tea, and various snacks line the table, along with a tarot deck.
But...
Aren't the seats reversed?
The coffee is placed at the tarot reader's seat.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No, it's correct.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're going to do a reading for me.
I am...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Consider it a test of all the things that you've learned so far.
... Okay.
I hold the tarot deck, shuffle the cards,
and spread them out in one smooth motion...
Whoops.
Arcana gently straightens the cards that didn't spread properly.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's okay to make mistakes.
... Thanks.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
Then...
Is there anything worrying you right now?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Not really, no.
Th-then, is there anything on your mind at all?
Or would you like to know more about your future?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Nope. I'm pretty happy right now.
... Hang on. I can't continue if you keep answering like that.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You'll be surprised how many customers are like this.
Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Watch.
Arcana smiles gently and reshuffles the cards.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. Is that so?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well then, I can still ascertain a few things.
Arcana looks into my eyes and flips the cards one by one.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The pain you carry.
*Flip*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Your worries.
*Flip*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And...
*Flip*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Your future.
Arcana points to the three flipped cards.
... Is that it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Far from it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I just threw something out there. Now you have to make up an explanation based on the cards.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Go on.
Now you want me to take over??

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I can't come up with anything right now, so yeah.
What the..
*Rattle, rattle*

lines.speaker: femaleguestvoice
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: femaleguestvoice
lines.text: I think it's closed.

lines.speaker: maleguestvoice
lines.text: Jeez, is this place ever open? Did they shut down?

lines.speaker: femaleguestvoice
lines.text: Maybe... I was really looking forward to a reading too.

lines.speaker: maleguestvoice
lines.text: Let's go get it done somewhere else.

lines.speaker: maleguestvoice
lines.text: There are plenty of other fortune-telling shops.

lines.speaker: femaleguestvoice
lines.text: But this place is supposed to be really accurate.

lines.speaker: femaleguestvoice
lines.text: It even predicted that you and I would end up going out.

lines.speaker: maleguestvoice
lines.text: So that's where you got the idea to come on that strong?

lines.speaker: femaleguestvoice
lines.text: Hey, I was right in the end, wasn't I?
Soon after, the voices of the two customers fades off into the distance.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: G-good thing I locked the door.
Y-yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway, you heard that, didn't you?
Heard what?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: How accurate I am.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm pretty sure I know exactly who those two were.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ninety-nine percent of the people who come to me for a reading end up becoming regulars.
Arcana glances at the three cards lying face up on the table,
then reshuffles the deck.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Okay. Let's try again.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: This time I won't act like a difficult customer.
I knew you were giving me a hard time on purpose.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, things get awkward when they act like that.
So for a while... no...
just for a short moment, we practice tarot.
The rest of the time, we just lounge side by side on the long sofa and chat.
*Jingle*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, right. I nearly forgot.
Arcana goes back into the shop,
then comes out holding some paper and a pen.
What are you doing?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm writing a notice about our booth at the festival.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'd feel bad if customers came all the way here for nothing, like those two earlier.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Plus, some promotion never hurts, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Speaking of, I should post it on my socials too.
Arcana sticks a sheet of paper on the door that reads: Whispers of Fate booth at the M.M.R. Vocational School Festival. See you there!
You think that'll really work?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course. Everyone who sees this will come.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The shop's been closed for a while now because of school.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Okay, all done.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. I didn't expect this, but I'm glad we came.
We head back to the dorm, chatting about what's in store for tomorrow's festival.
